column1: # Known problem replays of the external corpus survey (ReplayCorpusSurveyTest, corpusTest with -Psc4j.corpus=<folder>).
# One line per replay that is not ok: <replay file name> TAB <class: suspicious or error> TAB <signals> TAB <note>.
# Keys are the original corpus file names, so the list serves any corpus folder layout.
# A replay that is not listed must be ok; a listed replay must keep its class. Remove an entry when its replay becomes ok.
# The classes and signals come from a full survey of the corpus.
